contradictions.fact: which approach/trailhead this route uses

claims.says: North Fork Sauk River Trailhead -> Mackinaw Shelter -> White Pass (~5,900-6,000 ft) -> Glacier Gap (~7,250-7,300 ft), the standard southern approach

"North Fork Sauk River Trailhead" at (48.05832,-121.28793), but its own note says: "Coordinate and elevation as published... for the Trinity Trailhead... The North Fork Sauk River trailhead is 20.2 mi away on a different approach: both of this route's approach waypoints — Buck Creek Pass at 9.5 mi and the Cool/Gerdine Basin camp above it — are reached from Trinity, and the route's own itinerary begins 'Trailhead to Buck Creek Pass, 12 mi'"
"Buck Creek Pass" (5,800 ft, 9.5 mi) and "Cool/Gerdine Basin Camp" (6,800 ft, 14 mi) — an eastern Trinity/Chiwawa approach
Day 1 "Trailhead to Buck Creek Pass" (12 mi, 3,200 ft gain); Day 2 "Continue to eastern high camp" reaching the Cool/Gerdine Basin

contradictions.why: The route's prose (overview, approach, approach_variants, pitch_detail, bail, bivy) consistently describes the North Fork Sauk / White Pass / Glacier Gap approach, but the waypoints list's own note explicitly says its "North Fork Sauk Trailhead" coordinates are actually the Trinity Trailhead, and both the waypoints and the itinerary then route the party via Buck Creek Pass and a "Cool/Gerdine Basin Camp" that match neither White Pass nor Glacier Gap in name, elevation, or distance — an entirely different (eastern, Trinity/Chiwawa) approach contaminating the waypoints/itinerary.
contradictions.internal_resolution: overview, approach, approach_variants, pitch_detail, bail, road, and approach_logistics (5 of 7 route fields) all agree on the North Fork Sauk/White Pass/Glacier Gap line; waypoints[1-2] and the itinerary days are the contaminated outliers.
